features: New Comments Module for Tickets: Added the ability for administrators, condo owners, and suppliers to communicate directly within a single maintenance ticket.

Comments Security & Permissions: Complete role isolation with strict checks. Admins can moderate or hide comments, while standard users and suppliers can only add, edit, or delete their own comments relative to their buildings.
Real-Time Notifications: Integrated automatic in-app and email notifications whenever a comment is added or updated on an assigned ticket.

Developer Note: After updating the code to the latest version and running migrations, it is necessary to run 'php artisan db:seed --class=RolesAndPermissionsSeeder' to align the newly inserted permissions.
